trap.label: expected ≠ esperar
trap.wrong: I'm expected your answer by Friday.
trap.right: I'm expecting your answer by Friday.
trap.why: O verbo expect não é "esperar" no sentido de aguardar com be expected. Be expected to = a gente espera que; expecting = aguardando.

opts: Staff are expected to wear ID.
The book was written from a nurse.
The book was written of a nurse.
The book was written by a nurse.
We could have gone by train.
mcq.why: could have + particípio = poderíamos ter ido (mas não fomos).

fix.wrong: They were suppose to meet at six.
fix.right: They were supposed to meet at six.

fix.wrong: He may has lost his wallet.
fix.right: He may have lost his wallet.
